test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Sting operations use __subterfuge__ to obtain material for stories.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Honesty"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** We will learn the meaning of the given words:

__
 
• **Subterfuge -** deceit used in order to achieve one's goal

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** He had to use *subterfuge* and bluff on many occasions.
 
 
 
• **​Honesty -** the quality of being honest 
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***They spoke with convincing *honesty* about their fears.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here let's see the meaning of the other given words:

 
• **Society -** the aggregate of people living together in a more or less ordered community.

 
 
• ***​Eg. ***Drugs, crime, and other dangers to *society*.
 
 
 
• **​Policy -** a course or principle of action adopted or proposed by an organization or individual 
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***The government's controversial economic *policies.*
 
 
 
• ​**Suspicion - **a feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true 
 
 
• ***​Eg***. She had a sneaking *suspicion *that he was laughing at her.
